goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:21 — Fallback locale files are preloaded only from ApplicationController, so jobs and mailers can still resolve fallback keys before the site-default or English catalogs are loaded.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `ensure_loaded!` is only called from `ApplicationController#set_locale` (line 160 in the diff). The new `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` method (lines 21-23 in config/initializers/i18n.rb) preloads fallback locale files, but this is only triggered through the controller path. Background jobs and mailers that use I18n with fallbacks would not go through ApplicationController, so they could attempt to resolve fallback keys before those locale catalogs are loaded. This is a real correctness issue where the fallback mechanism may not work properly in non-controller contexts.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but ignores its stored mappings, exposing a misleading mutable-map contract to I18n and future callers.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that FallbackLocaleList extends Hash but overrides [] to always compute a fresh fallback list rather than using stored values. This is a valid design concern - the class inherits mutable Hash methods (like []=, merge, etc.) that would have no effect since [] ignores stored data. While this works for the current I18n.fallbacks use case, it creates a misleading API contract. This is a legitimate architectural concern about the implementation choice, not a bug since the code functions correctly for its intended purpose.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:20 — Locale preloading is coupled to the fallback configuration object, mixing lookup policy with backend-loading side effects.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that FallbackLocaleList has an ensure_loaded! method (line 20-22) that performs backend loading side effects (calling I18n.ensure_loaded! for each locale). This mixes the responsibility of defining fallback lookup order (the [] method) with triggering locale loading. This is a legitimate architectural concern - the fallback configuration object is now responsible for both policy (which locales to fall back to) and side effects (ensuring locales are loaded). However, this is a design/architecture concern rather than a bug, as the code will function correctly.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — The new fallback/preload behavior has no test coverage for locale order and missing-translation fallback cases.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new FallbackLocaleList class with custom fallback logic (locale -> site default -> :en) and an ensure_loaded! method. This is non-trivial new behavior that affects how translations fall back across locales. The finding correctly identifies that this new logic lacks test coverage. The diff shows no test files being added or modified, and the fallback ordering logic in the [] method is a specific, testable behavior that could have edge cases (e.g., when locale equals default_locale, when default_locale is :en, etc.).
